descFull: Bridge WeChat, WeCom & Telegram to local Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode & Pi. Keep the native terminal experience & CLI options with bidirectional interaction, multi-session bridging, CLI switching, file transfer, approvals & status sync. 微信、企业微信与 Telegram 接入本地 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi，保留原生终端体验与高级启动参数，支持原生双向交互、多会话桥接、多 CLI 切换、文件传输、审批交互与运行状态同步。
